content: First of all, it is questionable how well current stance detection methods perform in a cross-lingual setting, as the multilingual datasets available today are relatively small, and specific to a single target BIBREF2, BIBREF3. Furthermore, specific models tend to be developed for each single target or pair of targets BIBREF4. Concerns have been raised that cross-target performance is often considerably lower than fully supervised performance BIBREF1.
